notice: Manually reviewed evaluation set for the ONE I analysis modules. The article corpus is the fictional demo dataset (backend/app/seed/demo_dataset.json). Every label below was assigned by reading the text, not by running the system.

grouping.description: Each demo article is assigned to the event it belongs to. All 105 article pairs are derived from these assignments and used to score the pairwise linking decision.

coverage.description: For a fixed development probe, whether each article reports it. 'not_applicable' means the article was published before the development happened.

probes.text: Meridian County officials ordered the evacuation of residents living within two kilometres of the plant.
Meridian County lifted the evacuation order for Fairmont Hollow on Wednesday after air quality readings returned to normal levels.
Shares in Vantor Industries fell 6.2% on Tuesday, the steepest single-day move in the company's shares since its listing.
The plan allows the construction of 1,400 homes on the former Harbourside rail yard.
About 1,800 workers took part in the strike, which began on 15 February.

number_equivalence.description: Whether two numerical claims describe the same thing and may therefore be compared.

pairs.left: County records show that 3,200 residents were evacuated from the area.
pairs.right: About 4,000 residents were evacuated from the area.
pairs.note: Same subject, unit and context; the values genuinely differ.

pairs.left: Vantor Industries said the release involved about 12 tonnes of industrial solvent.
pairs.right: The company said the release involved about 9 tonnes of industrial solvent.

pairs.left: Air quality monitors recorded readings above the legal limit at 30% of measurement stations.
pairs.right: Air quality monitors recorded readings above the legal limit at 20% of measurement stations.
pairs.note: Difference must be expressed as 10 percentage points.

pairs.left: The dock workers union said the agreement gives a 4.5% pay increase for the current year.
pairs.right: The agreement gives a 4.2% pay increase for the current year, according to the port authority.

pairs.left: The plan allows the construction of 1,400 homes on the former Harbourside rail yard.
pairs.right: The plan allows the construction of 1,200 homes on the former Harbourside rail yard.

pairs.left: Council documents state that 25% of the homes will be sold or let below market rates.
pairs.right: Council documents state that 30% of the homes will be sold or let below market rates.

pairs.left: About 1,800 workers took part in the strike.
pairs.right: About 2,000 workers took part in the strike.

pairs.left: About 240 workers were on site at the time of the release.
pairs.right: About 240 workers were on site at the time of the release.
pairs.note: Sources agree; still a valid comparison.

pairs.left: About 4,000 residents were evacuated from the area.
pairs.right: About 4,000 residents attended the county meeting last year.
pairs.note: Same number and unit, different subject and period.

pairs.left: The release involved about 12 tonnes of industrial solvent.
pairs.right: About 12 residents were treated at the scene.

pairs.left: Shares in Vantor Industries fell 6.2% on Tuesday.
pairs.right: Readings were above the legal limit at 6.2% of measurement stations.
pairs.note: A percentage change is not a percentage level.

pairs.left: The share of affected stations rose by 10 percentage points over the period.
pairs.right: The share of affected stations was 10% over the period.
pairs.note: Percentage points and percent are different quantities.

pairs.left: The company reported a 4.5 million dollars charge for the quarter.
pairs.right: The regulator issued a $2 million fine to the operator.

pairs.left: Unemployment in the county was 6% in 2024.
pairs.right: Unemployment in the county was 5% in 2025.
pairs.note: Different time periods must not be compared as one claim.

wording_difference.description: Whether a pair of passages should be shown to the reader as a meaningful wording difference.

pairs.left: Vantor Industries admitted that a valve at the plant had not been inspected since 2023.
pairs.right: Vantor Industries responded to allegations that a valve at its plant was overdue for inspection.

pairs.left: The Meridian County Fire Department described the incident as a severe chemical leak.
pairs.right: A spokesperson described the incident as a limited release that was contained within the plant boundary.

pairs.left: Inspectors said Vantor mishandled the maintenance schedule for a valve that failed.
pairs.right: Vantor Industries confirmed that a valve failure caused the release.

pairs.left: Meridian City Council approved the Harbourside housing plan on Sunday evening.
pairs.right: Meridian City Council pushed through the Harbourside housing plan despite objections from residents.

pairs.left: The county halted operations at the site on Tuesday.
pairs.right: The county suspended operations at the site on Tuesday.

pairs.left: The port authority said container operations would restart on Friday morning.
pairs.right: The port authority said container operations would restart on Friday morning.

pairs.left: The union said members voted to accept the agreement at meetings held on Wednesday evening.
pairs.right: Union members voted to accept the agreement at meetings held on Wednesday evening.

pairs.left: Residents of the Harbourside district objected to the height of the proposed buildings.
pairs.right: The forecast for the region is mild for the weekend.
pairs.note: Unrelated passages carry no comparable wording.
